text:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we're repeatedly losing track of remediation owners and timelines after the write-path KV incidents. Proposing a very short "follow-up playbook" + an IC rotation tweak so ownership actually lands. Thoughts?
sam: +1. The KV recurring pattern needs explicit owner + due date. Can we also add auto-reminders and a simple recurrence flag?
kevin: From product side: prefer a single named owner per action (no 'infra' or 'team'), and SLA-style targets for remediation (P1: 2w, P2: 4w).
anya: Agreed. My suggested minimal template: owner, due_date, verification_steps, rollback_plan, recurrence_flag. Also a small 'done criteria' so closures are meaningful.
maria: Drafting a tiny template here — if we like it I'll make a GH issue template + a tracker row.
```
Owner: <name>
Priority: P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Verification: link to smoke test / checklist
Done criteria: e.g. "no errors >72h, latency within X%"
Recurring?: yes/no + notes on pattern
Postmortem link: <url>
Notes: short root-cause + mitigation
```
jess: Can we add a "comms cadence" field too? Who to ping at 24h/72h and a status cadence (daily while open, then weekly until done).
sam: Also propose IC-run 15-min sync 48h after incident to confirm owners and timelines — prevents items falling into someone's inbox.
incident-bot: Tip: you can setup channel reminders with `/remind #eng-oncall in 48 hours to review postmortem followups` or link to a GH project card automation.
maria: For IC rotation: consider 2-week rotations instead of 4, and add a "shadow" role during major release weeks so knowledge stays warmed up. That should reduce churn in continuity.
kevin: :thumbsup: shorter rotations seem sensible for on-call knowledge distribution. Ops needs a simple way to keep the calendar up to date.
anya: I'll update the rota spreadsheet and add a small handoff checklist row: current incidents, open actions, assigned owners, contact points.
sam: If everyone ok, maria can create the tracker + GH template, and I'll help wire up the Slack reminders and a webhook to update the tracker when issues close.
maria: Sounds good — I'll create the GH template + initial tracker rows and post links here by EOD. Assigning preliminary owners for outstanding actions: @kevin (KV mitigation), @jess (verification/tests), @sam (automation for reminders).
jess: Ack. I'll add verification tests and a smoke job to the CI.
maria: Thanks all — will post the draft and the automation steps later today :pray:
